text: I am. Good morning, your honors, and may it please the court. My name is Ronald Sullivan, and I represent the appellant, Rose Haar. We have put forth seven independent grounds for the court to consider, which we maintain requires reversal. The seven are independent. They are not reliant on each other. Any one in our argument is sufficient for reversal. The first argument, your honor, is one where there is significant doctrinal support. And what we have here is a potential conviction based on a charge where the, or an instruction where only assistance, a different sort of mens rea was present. And that's our argument here.
